app.title: EmotionalSense-P3 launcher
welcome.heading: Choose your game disc
welcome.body: Pick the ISO, CHD or CSO of DJMAX Portable 3, Korean version (ULKS46236). Everything is prepared on this computer; nothing is uploaded and no game files are included with this launcher.
welcome.update_soon: Update 1.02 support is coming in a later version.
welcome.wrong_region: This is {title} [{id}]. Only the Korean version (ULKS46236) is supported.
welcome.not_psp: This file is not a PSP game image.
welcome.folder_found: Found the extracted game in the folder "{name}" next to the program. Continue to use it (it is copied, never moved or changed), or choose an ISO, CHD or CSO instead.
welcome.have_game: Game already prepared on this computer.
prepare.heading: Preparing the game
prepare.first_run: This only happens the first time (and after an update). It can take a few minutes.
prepare.cancelled: Cancelled. You can start again any time.
prepare.rebuild_notice: The launcher was updated, so the game is rebuilt once.
main.backup_none: There is no save to back up yet.
main.game_missing: The game is not prepared yet.
options.hint_unlock: Unlocking is written to your save the first time the game saves. Back up the save first if you want it untouched.
err.kit_missing: The build tools are missing from this installation: {path}
err.no_vulkan: The Vulkan graphics library was not found. Install your graphics driver.
err.not_iso: This does not look like a PSP game image.
err.chd_nolib: CHD support is missing from this installation (libchdr was not found). Use an ISO, or reinstall the launcher.
err.chd_invalid: This file is not a valid CHD image.
err.folder_incomplete: The game folder {path} cannot be used: {what}. It needs the extracted DJMAX Portable 3 disc (PSP_GAME with PARAM.SFO of ULKS46236, SYSDIR/EBOOT.BIN and the INSDIR/USRDIR .TPA files).
err.chd_corrupt: This CHD is damaged or incomplete and could not be read ({what}). Copy it again, or create it again from the ISO with chdman.
err.cso_corrupt: This CSO is damaged or incomplete and could not be read ({what}). Copy it again, or create it again from the ISO.
err.cso_invalid: This file is not a CSO the launcher can read ({what}).
err.chd_unsupported: This CHD is not a PSP disc image the launcher can read ({what}). Use a CHD that chdman createdvd or createcd made from the game's ISO.
err.decrypt_failed: Could not decrypt the game executable.
err.recomp_failed: The game code could not be recompiled.
err.delay_slots: The recompiled code failed its safety check.
cli.not_prepared: The game is not prepared. Run with --iso <file> first.
cli.selftest_ok: Self-test passed: the bundled compiler built and ran the runtime test.
options.hint_confirm: Circle confirms in the Asian versions, cross in the Western ones. In-game it only applies to menus, never to the lanes.
options.hint_refresh: Alt+Enter in the game toggles borderless full screen; F11 uses the rate chosen here (60 or 120 Hz exclusive when set; Borderless keeps the desktop rate). The game runs at 59.94 Hz: 60 or 120 Hz shows every frame evenly, 75 or 144 Hz repeats some.
options.hint_bga: Softens the 30 fps background video by blending frames (the lane and notes are not affected; the video is delayed by one frame, 17 ms). Off by default.
options.hint_update: Optional. Pick the folder that holds PSP/GAME/ULKS46236/DATA.TPA; the disc image is never changed. Left removes it, Enter changes it.
update.installed: Update installed: {count} data packages replace the disc's.
update.is_exe: That is the update's patcher program, which is not used. Pick the folder with PSP/GAME/ULKS46236/DATA.TPA.
update.not_found: No DATA.TPA of the update was found there.
update.bad_file: That DATA.TPA is not a valid game data file.
update.no_match: That DATA.TPA does not match this game's data.
options.hint_fever: Respect: Fever starts by itself when the gauge fills and the lane speed stays as you set it at Fever x4 and above. Original: Fever starts with the {fever_btn} button and the lane speeds up at x4 and above, as on the PSP. In MISSION mode the Original rules always apply.
options.hint_score: Respect: the score is your judgment percentage out of 1,000,000 (87.8% = 878,000), on the result screen and in the song list. Original: the PSP score. The game keeps both records; only the chosen one is shown. In MISSION mode the Original rules always apply.
options.hint_speed: Respect: Auto Velocity. R and L change the speed in steps of 0.1 (1.0 to 7.0) and what you choose is the apparent speed: 2.0 looks the same on a 100 and a 200 BPM song. Original: the PSP speeds, 0.5 to 7.0 in steps of 0.5. In MISSION mode the Original rules always apply.
options.hint_startmode: Window or borderless full screen. Alt+Enter switches in the game. On a Steam Deck in game mode it starts in full screen.
portable.not_writable:
EmotionalSense-P3 keeps all its data next to the program, but this folder cannot be written to:
{path}
Move EmotionalSense-P3 to a folder you can write to (for example Documents or a Games folder) and start it again.
({error})
portable.migrate_none: No data from an older version was found.
crash.title: The game closed unexpectedly
renderer.title: Vulkan did not start
options.hint_texpack: Sharper textures built on this computer from your own disc with free AI models, downloaded once ({size} MB). Needs a Vulkan graphics driver and about {minutes} minutes the first time.
texpack.body: This builds a 4x texture pack from your own disc. It downloads free upscaling tools and AI models (about {size} MB, once), plays the game in the background to collect its textures, then upscales them on your graphics card. It takes about {minutes} minutes. Nothing is uploaded.
texpack.credits: Credits: waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan and its cunet models (MIT, nihui); Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan (MIT) with realesrgan-x4plus (BSD-3-Clause, xinntao); 4xTextureDAT2_otf by Philip Hofmann (CC BY 4.0).
texpack.done: Done: {count} textures. High-res textures are on.
texpack.cancelled: Cancelled. Start again to continue where it stopped.
texpack.no_vulkan: This option needs a Vulkan graphics driver, and none was found.
texpack.no_net: Could not download the tools (is the network down?): {error}
texpack.unsupported: Not available on this platform yet: the upscaling tools have no {arch} build.
options.hint_buttons: The game's button prompts (OK, Cancel, Yes, No, ...) and this launcher show the buttons of the chosen pad: Xbox (coloured A B X Y), Steam Deck (A B X Y) or Switch (B A Y X by position). Auto follows the controller used last. Only the Vulkan renderer repaints the game's prompts.
options.hint_triggers: In 3.2T, 4.2T and 6.2T songs the left and right triggers play the side notes like the analog stick (the stick still works, and E and R do the same on the keyboard). L/R: the triggers are L and R, which change the speed, as in version 0.1. Everywhere else the triggers are L and R.
options.hint_confirm_letter: {east} confirms in the Asian versions, {south} in the Western ones. In-game it only applies to menus, never to the lanes.
